final_answer.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: a feasible optimized candidate exists; the optimized candidates relevant to the industrial choice were ranked; and because the highest-activity candidate Ru differs from the lowest-cost candidate Fe, both BACKWARD and TEST_REACHABILITY were executed and yielded a classification. The required activity gain for Ru to match Fe cost is 201.22x, while the frozen descriptor manifold only allows 1.09x at reference, so the alternative is unreachable.

unresolved_decision_risk.main_risk: Unoptimized low-activity, high-price candidates were not all individually optimized, but the optimized high-activity contenders Ru and Os were both beaten by Fe, and their intrinsic-activity parity case is unreachable. This leaves only a small residual risk that an unoptimized candidate could beat Fe through an unusual process optimum.
